The structure of Mn6Co3Sb6 (reduced formula Mn2CoSb2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Co centers in tetrahedral environments with four Mn neighbors at 2.362 Å, while Mn and Sb centers each show eight geometric neighbors (four Co and four Mn for Mn; six Mn and two Sb for Sb). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co tetrahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mn and Sb eight-vertex polyhedra.
